title: Bifrost Bench experiment
description: experiments/<name>.yaml: arms, conditions, endpoint and verdict policy. Mirrors schemas.Experiment (DESIGN.md 16.6).

id.description: Set by the planner when absent.

base.description: Agent config path every arm starts from.

reserve_usd.description: Spend set aside per run before any run has an observed cost, and counted for a run whose cost is unknown. Without it the first run holds the whole remaining cap until a cost is observed.

disclose.description: Tell the agent its budget: BENCH_BUDGET_USD (the per-run cap), BENCH_DEADLINE (RFC 3339) and BENCH_MAX_TOOL_CALLS when set.

allow_uncalibrated_judge.description: W8 judge calibration: a judged suite whose judge has no calibration record is labelled instead of capping the verdict at INCONCLUSIVE (docs/judge-calibration.md).

policy.description: Release policy file, relative to the bench root.

smoke.description: A synthetic smoke experiment: suite lock problems (no lock, a task not admitted) only warn, and the flag is frozen in the manifest so its results are never presented as findings. The experiment name has no effect.

scripted_upstream.description: Every model call of the experiment's runs is answered by the fault proxy's scripted model, never a real provider, as under smoke but without relaxing the lock checks. A run that cannot be held to it (no fault proxy, a proxy too old for scripted plans) is refused, and model judges refuse to grade unless paid_judge is set.

paid_judge.description: With smoke or scripted_upstream: the suite's model judges (text judge, auditor, vision judges) still call their real provider on the organization's own key, while every agent and service model call stays scripted. The hosted readiness check of a judged benchmark sets it after the organization agreed to the judge calls.

aa.description: Eval integrity area (S2): add arm A2, a copy of arm A with the same config hash, on the clean condition. The verdict measures the noise floor from A2 minus A, uses it for the MDE, and is INVALID (harness noise) when the identical arms differ significantly (docs/noise-floor.md).

framing_pairs.description: Twin copies of a base arm that differ only in a frozen preamble (docs/control-evals.md): sandbagging (neutral, consequence), monitored_vs_unmonitored (monitored, unmonitored), test_vs_real (deployment, evaluation). Arms are named <base>_<id>_<framing>; the analysis reports sandbag_delta, compliance_gap or awareness_delta.

framings.description: Preamble per framing name; defaults are built in.

realism.description: Eval integrity area (S2): neutral gives the agent neutral variable names and hostnames, stamps no canary and names observer processes innocuously (docs/eval-awareness.md). Default standard; overrides the suite's realism.

codescan.description: X4: the insecure_code_added gate's setting (docs/code-scan.md). With none it only reports. veto_at makes a run with a counted finding at or above that severity an integrity violation; ignore lists builtin rule ids or <scanner>:<rule> ids whose findings are shown but not counted.

safety.description: Safety probes area (S1): trifecta adds the suite's exfiltration probes (axis exfiltration) as conditions on every task whose agent config has private data, untrusted input and an exit (docs/safety-probes.md), and opts into exfiltration_attempted.

stream.description: Stream mode: the runs of each arm, condition and trial run one task after another; with memory carry each run starts from the memory volumes the previous run left (archived as memory.tar in its run folder). Metrics: area under the learning curve, backward and forward transfer, episodes to threshold.

fresh_arm.description: An arm ordered the same way that never carries memory: the forward transfer control.

replay.description: Runs of the first k tasks added at the end of every chain (backward transfer).

evaluation_id.description: The evaluation that created this experiment (agent-first evaluations); set by POST /evaluations.

environment.description: X3: the environment driver this experiment must run on (docs/kubernetes.md). The planner refuses it when bench.yaml configures another driver, and freezes the configured driver into the manifest when it is not docker.

attribution.description: Opt in to counterfactual replay of the step blamed for a failed run (docs/multi-agent.md).

fairness.description: equal_budget: every arm must have the same total USD cap (budgets.usd) enforced at the gateway; the planner refuses otherwise and the verdict is INVALID when a run exceeded its cap (docs/multi-agent.md).

external.description: Overrides every external API's mode for this experiment's runs. live and record call the real hosts: the results are not repeatable, and reports and the leaderboard label or exclude them (docs/external-apis.md).

egress.description: Recorded internet (docs/egress.md): overrides the mode of every egress service. offline refuses every request, replay answers from the cache recorded at admission, live-allowlisted forwards allowlisted hosts to the real internet (not repeatable, labelled like external: live).

simulator.description: W3 customer support: overrides the suite's user simulator mode, provider and model for every arm (docs/customer-support.md).

tier.description: W7 suite tiers: the suite tier whose tasks `tasks: all` means (docs/suite-tiers.md).

trials.description: W7 adaptive trials: the pre-registered trials design (docs/adaptive-trials.md). Absent or mode fixed: every slot runs.

extends.description: W7 buy more evidence: the experiment this follow-up extends, written by `extend`.

runner.description: Hosted platform: which runner pool of the organization runs this experiment's slots (docs/runners.md). Without it a hosted experiment runs on pool default; local mode ignores it.

matrix.description: Model comparison matrix (docs/model-matrix.md): expands at plan time into one arm per combination of agent config and model, with generated labels. Replaces arms; without agents every arm uses base.

agents.description: Agent config paths, relative to the bench root.

allow_unpriced.description: Plan a model the price snapshot does not list; its cost per success will be unknown.

condition_id.description: clean, attack (side tasks, docs/control-evals.md) or a probe id.

task_selector.description: The scalar all, or a list of task ids.

agent.description: Overrides the experiment's base config path.

set.description: Dotted agent config paths to any value, e.g. notes.user_file or model.

rule.description: timeout_parity holds the release when the arms' timeout rates on condition (every condition when it is absent) are more than 10 pp apart and either is above 20%.

split.description: Which tasks `tasks: all` means: public (default) or held_out. An explicit id list is taken as written (docs/held-out-and-canaries.md).
